# Packed AAC vectors

Synthetic 440 Hz sine encoded as stereo AAC-LC, 44.1 kHz, 53 frames. Generated by
`scripts/generate_packed_fixtures.py`; provenance, tool versions and SHA-256 values
are in `manifest.json`. The synthetic inputs and fixture wrapper are MIT licensed.

`clear` contains ID3 PRIV anchors and ADTS frames. `aes128` uses independent OpenSSL
whole-resource AES-CBC with PKCS#7; `sample_aes` encrypts eligible complete AAC blocks
after the 16-byte clear leader, restarting CBC per frame. Keys/IVs are public test
vectors. The independent verifier compares decoded output with the clear ADTS
stream, not just with a second output of the transmuxer.
